description:
Her life was forged in misfortune from the very beginning.

At twenty, she woke up in a hospital bed with no memories—and saw something she never should have on her way out. From that day on, Seo Iyeon lived every moment in desperate survival.

Desperate to be okay. Desperate to be normal. Desperate not to die of loneliness.

After years of grueling effort, the endless cracks in her life were finally gathering dust, on the verge of being forgotten forever.

Until...

*“Have you ever lost something important?”*

On her twenty-ninth birthday, a mysterious man appears before her. And the fragile peace on the surface of Iyeon’s life begins to shatter all over again.
